brief:
Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners investment fund earned substantial returns this week after disclosures revealed it held more than $456 million in Israeli companies supplying Israel's military, Dawn reported. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Affinity Partners' largest investor, benefited from those profits.

The disclosure raises questions about financial interests tied to the Gaza conflict, as major international investors profit from companies supporting Israeli military operations.
dek: This week we learned that Jared Kushner’s notorious investment fund, Affinity Partners, made an absolute killing on its investment in an Israeli financial conglomerate that held more than $456 million in Israeli companies supplying Israel’s military. And as by far Affinity Partners’ biggest investor, Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) has benefited from those profits.
title: Kushner fund profits from Israeli military suppliers through Saudi investment
